name: racecar-skidpad
$comment: Steady-state cornering at 25 m/s: a staircase of left steering inputs (0.04, 0.08, 0.12 of full lock), the speed held by a PI on the accelerator. Lateral acceleration, yaw rate, body slip and the four tyre loads against the nonlinear four-wheel steady state and the linear bicycle model (design/reference.py).

options.text: 25 m/s with three left steering levels. The race car is slightly oversteering at low lateral acceleration and the loads move to the right-hand tyres.
